summary: sent data with no name lookup
reason: com.weather.widget.lite sent about 2 MB during the monitor window without looking up a single name, which means it talks to fixed addresses. Some media and gaming apps do this; so does software that avoids leaving a trail.
remediation: Check Settings > Apps > com.weather.widget.lite > Mobile data and Wi Fi usage. If the app has no reason to send that much, uninstall it.
